title: Amgen says cloud data breach exposed patient health, proprietary info
description: Pharmaceutical company Amgen says it suffered a data breach after threat actors stole corporate data and patient information stored in multiple cloud systems operated by third-party service providers. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: Arch Linux disables AUR package adoption to stop malware flood
description: The Arch Linux project has temporarily disabled adoption of Arch User Repository (AUR) packages after a surge in malicious takeovers of existing packages. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: Online ad firm Adform’s script compromised to steal cryptocurrency
description: Online advertising firm Adform suffered a supply-chain attack that delivered cryptocurrency-stealing scripts to websites using its ad platform, replacing wallet addresses copied to visitors' clipboards with ones controlled by an attacker. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: OpenAI says its new GPT 5.6 models are becoming more cost-efficient
description: OpenAI says it has reduced the price of two GPT-5.6 models, cutting Luna's API price by 80% and Terra's by 20% as it works to make its models more efficient. [...]
author: Mayank Parmar

title: Hacker uses DeepSeek AI to autonomously attack vulnerable servers
description: A Chinese-speaking threat actor is using the DeepSeek AI model and the open-source Hermes Agent to conduct autonomous cyberattacks on exposed servers with limited human involvement. [...]
author: Lawrence Abrams

title: CISA warns of cyberattacks disrupting U.S. water utilities
description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning of a significant increase in attacks targeting internet-exposed programmable logic controllers (PLCs) in the water and wastewater systems sector. [...]
author: Bill Toulas

title: ESET tracks rise in malicious AI skills and adaptable malware
description: Attackers are adapting established techniques to AI platforms, emerging technologies, and changing user behavior. ESET's new threat report examines the rise of malicious AI skills, AI-assisted malware, ClickFix attacks, record quishing activity, and ransomware tools designed to disable security software. [...]
